speaker: village
text: Year 10: 15 food appears in the pile for 12 people.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gathers Ryn, Roan to talk.

speaker: a011
text: Bram is dead and Taric is dead, and the pile's got fifteen for twelve of us — that's more breathing room than we've had in years, but I want us at the pile early before Mako decides this is the year he stops being polite about it. Ryn, you're at zero food coming out of last year and that doesn't stand; Roan, same question I always ask you: how hungry are you walking into this morning?

speaker: a010
text: Hungry enough that I ate nothing last year and I'm still standing, which tells me I've been leaning on Eron longer than a father should. I'll be at the pile early — two food is what I need to keep breathing, and I won't reach past that. What are you thinking about Mako?

speaker: a011
text: Mako's sitting on zero food same as Ryn, which means he's going to the pile hungry and a hungry Mako is unpredictable — but he's also got Zinn and a daughter's loyalty pulling at him, so he's not going to do anything that makes the whole village turn cold on him the year after Bram died proving what that costs. Ryn, you take two from the pile before anyone counts you out, and Roan, you take your two and don't wait to see who moves first. I'll be right behind both of you.
